details.detail: section heading, divider, and item count form one line
details.authority: official readonly-detail composition: TDesign Starter detail/base and detail/advanced
details.resolution: Superseded reference detail, not a contract obligation. The daily-frontend snapshot the reference screenshots were captured from printed an item count on the section heading line; the official TDesign Starter (aeed57076217f7777158b905f353d73585bad1c4) renders a section title as the card head only - measured t-card__header border-bottom is 0px and its #actions slot carries controls (quarter/month), never a count. An item count is a presentation derivation of the facts the section already renders, so Contract V2 must not carry an item-count presentation field, and the frontend must not fail a section for omitting one. See the superseding wording in page-pattern-reference-contract-gaps-v1.md.
